info.title: nuScenes-dataset
info.subtitle: Full sensor data (Camera, LiDAR, Radar) for the nuScenes v1.0 keyframes
info.description:
This dataset provides the Keyframes Only subset of the official nuScenes v1.0 release. It is designed for researchers who require full multi-modal sensor data (6x Cameras, 1x LiDAR, 5x Radar) for 3D object detection but do not need the unannotated high-frequency temporal frames between keyframes. 

**Dataset Contents**
- Synchronized Samples: Image, LiDAR, and Radar data for all 40,000 annotated keyframes.
- Annotations: Complete 3D bounding boxes with class labels and attributes.
- Metadata: Relational JSON tables for ego-pose, sensor calibration, and scene information.
- Maps: Rasterized expansion maps for drivable area and lane geometry.

**Exclusions**
This dataset does not include the un-annotated intermediate frames (sweeps). The intermediate sweeps were removed to reduce the total size from 1.3TB to approximately 58GB. Since manual annotations are only provided for keyframes (at 2Hz), the sweeps are unnecessary for most standard 3D object detection and sensor fusion tasks. 

**Use Cases**
- 3D Object Detection: Training detectors using single or multi-modal sensor inputs.
- Sensor Fusion: Developing architectures that fuse Camera, LiDAR, and Radar data.
- BEV Perception: Predicting road geometry and occupancy grids from a Bird’s-Eye-View.
- Mapping: Lane and drivable area segmentation using provided map layers.

**References**
Original dataset and documentation: https://www.nuscenes.org/
